pretraining_linguistic_data.purpose: Build broad language exposure from licensed prose and carefully reviewed original instructional texts.
pretraining_linguistic_data.unit: Document or section with source, author, version, license, and group_id metadata.
quality_controls: human authorship or verified source provenance

future_conversational_tuning.purpose: Teach response behavior after a separate future authorization, without pretending that the small pretraining corpus alone creates conversational ability.
future_conversational_tuning.unit: Human-authored multi-turn scenario record with roles, intent, difficulty, safety notes, provenance, reviewer, and group_id.
quality_controls: holdout scenario groups kept isolated only in a future approved split plan

recording_requirements: record a human author or authorized contributor identity outside training text
record the exact license and consent status
store source facts separately from the response text
mark uncertainty, refusal, correction, and tool-result boundaries explicitly
redact personal data before any derived training file is created
keep each scenario family and all revisions under a stable group_id

scale_planning.estimate_note: All token counts are planning estimates, not tokenizer outputs. UTF-8 byte ranges use a conservative 4.0 to 5.5 bytes per future token and must be measured only after an approved collection.

scenarios.recommended_mix: No family above 25 percent; include institutional, technical, educational, original explanatory, and later authorized human dialogue material.
scenarios.limitation: Enough for controlled small-model experiments, not enough to establish robust general language, instruction following, factual reliability, or natural conversation.

scenarios.recommended_mix: Cap any author, journal, site template, or source family; add deliberately authored service and dialogue data only under a separate protocol.
scenarios.limitation: Broader than the initial scenario but still far below what supports a generally competent assistant trained from scratch; quality depends more on provenance and diversity than raw volume.

architecture_limitations: The frozen v0.4 architecture is small and was trained on a very limited historical corpus.
More tokens alone do not create grounded knowledge, safe tool use, reliable reasoning, or a stable assistant persona.
Conversational quality requires separate human-authored behavior data, evaluation, and future safety review.
The scenarios are experimental corpus targets, not claims of sufficient data for a general AI.

batch_ingestion_architecture.approval_gate: Only a user-approved, enumerated source list can enter a batch. Unlisted URLs, mirrors, attachments, and substitutions are rejected before download.
batch_ingestion_architecture.group_id_strategy: Assign a stable group_id before any future split: all versions, translations, mirrors, author-related revisions, and documents derived from one source work share the group. No future train, validation, or test split may place members of one group in different partitions.
batch_ingestion_architecture.split_policy: No split is created in Phase 2G. A future authorized split plan must operate after approval and group assignment, keeping the final test groups isolated until one final evaluation.

items.justification: Single named technical guide with an identifiable edition and reported CC BY 4.0 notice.
items.risks: PDF extraction, screenshots, references, and third-party examples.
acceptance_criteria: official named edition is available
CC BY 4.0 notice is captured with the original
text layer is usable
third-party assets can be excluded or documented
no unresolved personal data
rejection_criteria: license notice is absent or incompatible
text cannot be separated from protected third-party content

items.justification: Public technical instructions with an official CC BY 4.0 notice and a naturally bounded endpoint list.
items.risks: Repeated generated schema text, external standards, and map or data attributions.
acceptance_criteria: approved finite endpoint list exists
every captured page resolves to the licensed service version
generated repeats are measurable
external standards and visual assets are excluded
provenance is retained per endpoint
rejection_criteria: near-duplicate rate prevents useful prose recovery
required text depends on unlicensed external material

items.justification: Adds Portuguese support and troubleshooting language from source-controlled documentation with an explicit repository license.
items.risks: Code, product marks, reusable fragments, source/locale mismatch, and duplicated localization content.
acceptance_criteria: each page maps to a CC BY 4.0 documentation source
only approved Markdown-backed pages are included
code and branded assets are separated
language variant is recorded
duplicates across versions are grouped
rejection_criteria: code or branded assets cannot be separated
the selected locale is not documented

items.justification: Bounded pt-BR tutorial and FAQ material broadens step-by-step programming explanation under an official license page.
items.risks: Version overlap, prose/code distinctions, upstream quotations, and incomplete translations.
acceptance_criteria: only named pt-BR tutorial and FAQ pages are used
PSF license notice is retained
code is labeled separately from prose
version and translation group_ids are assigned
no unrelated external page is followed
rejection_criteria: translation or version provenance is unclear
duplicate or generated index text dominates
